<div class="review-text">
Six of Crows was well written, but dull at times and had a little bit too much fantasy-nazi sympathy for my tastes. Could have been shortened maybe 40% without losing any of its value, I think- around the middle I ended up setting it down for a month or two due to this particular problem. Aside from the sympathetic portrayal of bigots, I suppose the representation in the story was pretty above-average for fantasy, which was nice.
</div>
